description: Captures the deterministic effect of a scripted forward-movement burst from E1M1 spawn on the player thinker: position deltas in fixed-point fixed_t units (FRACUNIT = 65536), the per-component state snapshot hashes (02-012), and the framebuffer hashes (02-011) at the start, mid, and end of the burst. Initial entries are empty pending external reference run.
captureMethod: From the 02-020 spawn state, hold the forward DOS scancode (FORWARD = 17 / W after configuration; vanilla uses the up arrow = 72 by default) for 35 tics, then release; capture framebuffer + state at tic 0, tic 17, and tic 35 of the burst window.
